corruptSays.line: Rosa looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.

◈ FLASHBACK — Photo Album
Faces from before. Niamh's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Knife roll
The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.

◈ FLASHBACK — Tasting Spoon
Your first Saturday service, you were sixteen and the chef handed you this spoon without a word. Tap twice, taste, know. You still tap twice — the tickets are gone but the habit isn't.

◈ FLASHBACK — Lucky Coin
Worn smooth. Gavriil flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.
Word reaches you, days late: Naran stands accused over what happened to Natalia. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.

Natalia has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Naran answers for what happened to Natalia.
Natalia calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

Kennedy leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

📓 Codex: you've SEEN Bloodhound now. Your nose changed days ago. Water has a smell now — and so does fear. You haven’t told anyone. People look at you funny when you find things by smell.
🔍 Mateo crouches over tall smooth stalks turning reddish-purple, with dark purple berry clusters in late summer, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
Naran showed Tetiana the tall smooth stalks turning reddish-purple, with dark purple berry clusters in late summer — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You notice the village gives you room on the path now. Not fear, exactly. Room.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 2). You can function through terror. Your hands shake but they work. This is a trained skill.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Managing Fear, Stone & Masonry. Your Codex overflows.

FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
People will notice: watches people's hands, not their faces — like appraising tools. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Emberhold bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
🔍 Brian has been turning over a huge smooth white ball sitting on the ground, sometimes head-sized for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
